review_output: {"summary":"No. The facts do not show that WP-04 can safely move to runtime scheduling. They show only that a staging Vercel project exists and is not live. Nothing in them satisfies the acceptance criteria. At least four blockers apply: there is no fixed non-Production scheduler target, no registered schedule, no data isolation, and no payment isolation. Authenticated invocation, duplicate-scheduler ownership, heartbeat, failure visibility and synthetic Email/reminder receipt are also unproven. Runtime scheduling must not proceed. Do not build new scheduler infrastructure just to get around the missing evidence.","findings":[{"severity":"BLOCKER","confidence":0.97,"area":"Scheduler target","file":"WP-04 platform facts: latestDeployment","issue":"No fixed non-Production scheduler target exists. The latest deployment has target=null, aliasCount=0, source=cli, and is explicitly not the current Goal source and not an accepted target.","evidence":"latestDeployment.target=null; aliasCount=0; claim says 'not current Goal source and not accepted as fixed scheduler target'; project.customEnvironmentCount=0; conclusion says staging project existence does not supply the target.","impact":"Scheduling against this deployment would use an unstable, unaccepted, possibly stale build. Preview READY state is not evidence of the Goal code or a fixed target.","recommended_fix":"Do not proceed. Obtain an explicitly approved, fixed, non-Production target (stable alias or custom environment) running the current Goal source. Record its deployment ID and commit SHA. Do this through the owner-approved process, not by ad hoc workarounds.","required_test":"Read-only check that the approved target is non-Production, has a stable identity, and that its deployed commit SHA matches the Goal source."},{"severity":"BLOCKER","confidence":0.97,"area":"Cron registration","file":"WP-04 platform facts: cronInventory","issue":"Zero cron jobs are registered. enabled=true only reflects the project setting and does not mean a schedule exists.","evidence":"cronInventory.registered=0, undeployed=0, modified=0, enabled=true.","impact":"No scheduler owns any job. Heartbeats, failure visibility and reminder delivery cannot occur, so the 'at least two continuous heartbeats' criterion is unmet.","recommended_fix":"Treat the scheduler as absent. Register a schedule only after a target is approved and isolation is proven, and only through the approved change path.","required_test":"After approved registration, the cron inventory shows the expected job(s) with the expected path and schedule, and at least two consecutive scheduled executions are logged without manual triggering."},{"severity":"BLOCKER","confidence":0.95,"area":"Data isolation","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified","issue":"Database isolation is unverified.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Database isolation'.","impact":"Any scheduled job could read or mutate Production or shared data, or send reminders to real customers. The 'verified data isolation' acceptance criterion is unmet.","recommended_fix":"Without reading secret values, verify through approved metadata or owner attestation that the target's database binding is distinct from Production. Do not run jobs until this is confirmed.","required_test":"Metadata check that DB host/identity for the target differs from Production, plus a synthetic-record write and read that appears only in the isolated store."},{"severity":"BLOCKER","confidence":0.95,"area":"Payment isolation","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified and user constraints","issue":"Non-Production payment isolation is unverified. Staging uses PayUni live credentials with NT$2/3 test plan prices, so the staging name does not prove isolation.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Non-Production payment isolation'. User constraint: staging uses PayUni live and NT/2/3 test plan prices.","impact":"Scheduled jobs, especially anything touching billing, could trigger real charges. The billing-cycle job must not run.","recommended_fix":"Keep the billing-cycle job excluded from the schedule. Require payment-provider sandbox or disabled-payment proof before enabling any scheduler in this environment. Allow only the reminder and confirmation-email paths and block payment paths.","required_test":"Prove that the billing-cycle path is not registered or invocable on the target, and that no PayUni live call can be made from the scheduled paths."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.9,"area":"Job authentication","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified","issue":"Job authentication injection and edge path allowance are unverified.","evidence":"notVerified lists 'Job authentication injection' and 'Edge path allowance'.","impact":"Invocation may fail with 401/403, or the endpoint may be open or blocked by deployment protection or middleware. Neither outcome satisfies 'authenticated job invocation'.","recommended_fix":"Verify, without reading secret values, that the platform injects the authorization for scheduled invocation and that the job path is allowed through edge/middleware. Also verify that unauthenticated requests are rejected.","required_test":"A scheduled invocation returns 2xx with valid auth, and an unauthenticated or wrong-auth request to the same path returns 401/403."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.88,"area":"Single scheduler ownership","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified","issue":"Duplicate schedulers outside Vercel are not ruled out.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Duplicate schedulers outside Vercel'. Only the Vercel Cron inventory was checked (empty).","impact":"An external scheduler such as GitHub Actions, another host, or a third-party cron could already invoke the endpoints. That would duplicate reminders and break the single-owner criterion.","recommended_fix":"Inventory non-Vercel schedulers (CI schedules, external cron services, DB schedulers, other projects) and document a single owner.","required_test":"Inventory shows exactly one scheduler owner for each job. Over an observation window, each scheduled slot produces exactly one invocation."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.9,"area":"Heartbeat and failure visibility","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified","issue":"There is no evidence of continuous heartbeats or of failure alerting and visibility.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Continuous scheduler heartbeat'. Cron registered=0. No failure-visibility fact is listed anywhere.","impact":"Silent scheduler failure would go undetected. One manual request or a READY state cannot prove continuity.","recommended_fix":"Define heartbeat logging and an alert or visible failure signal. Collect at least two consecutive scheduled runs, plus one controlled non-Production failure case.","required_test":"At least two consecutive scheduled heartbeats at the expected interval, and a deliberately failed non-Production run that surfaces in logs or alerts."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.9,"area":"Synthetic delivery","file":"WP-04 platform facts: notVerified","issue":"Synthetic confirmation Email and reminder receipt are unverified. LINE provider delivery is also unverified.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Synthetic Email delivery' and 'LINE provider delivery'.","impact":"The end-to-end acceptance outcome is unproven. Unsafe provider settings could send to real recipients.","recommended_fix":"Use synthetic recipients on a controlled mailbox only, with the provider path confirmed non-Production. Do not send to real customers. Record receipt evidence.","required_test":"A synthetic booking produces a confirmation Email and a reminder, both received at the test mailbox. The evidence shows no real-customer recipients."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.88,"area":"Source/version provenance","file":"WP-04 platform facts: latestDeployment, notVerified","issue":"The Goal source is not confirmed deployed. The latest deployment was uploaded via CLI from an unknown source.","evidence":"notVerified includes 'Current Goal source deployed'. latestDeployment.source=cli with no commit provenance.","impact":"Runtime results would not reflect the code under review. An unknown build could contain different cron handlers or auth logic.","recommended_fix":"Establish provenance (commit SHA, built from a clean tree) for the approved target before collecting any evidence.","required_test":"Deployment metadata or a build manifest maps the target to the exact Goal commit SHA."},{"severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.75,"area":"Evidence interpretation","file":"WP-04 platform facts: verified","issue":"The 'verified' items are negative or neutral facts, and 'live=false' could be misread as isolation.","evidence":"Verified items: project exists, READY with null target, live=false, no alias, no custom environments, empty cron inventory. None establish isolation.","impact":"A reviewer or automation could read status LIVE_METADATA_VERIFIED as readiness and proceed unsafely.","recommended_fix":"Rename the status to something like 'METADATA_ONLY_NOT_READY'. State in the report that live=false and the staging name do not prove data or payment isolation.","required_test":"The WP-04 gate checklist maps each acceptance criterion to explicit positive evidence. Any criterion marked 'not verified' blocks progression."}]}
